text.fallback: Head out: Jack the Ripper and Zeppeli the Strange, Part 4

outro.fallback: Zeppeli, unfazed, pokes a clean hole in the bottom of his wine bottle with his finger.
As he reminds the other two to stand back, deciding to fight the zombie by himself, Jack the Ripper jumps out of the horse's corpse.
